craft_notes: Sthāyin: letter-yoga (Hareesh Yukti #14 note in lore). Sanskrit: yasya kasyāpi varṇasya pūrvāntāv anubhāvayet...pumān bhavet → L4 keeps any-letter + ends-contemplated + becomes. Rows: row 3 (by-void→becomes). Close: becomes (bhavet — transformation verb is the whole claim). Rejected: 'phoneme' — killed: letter kept; 'spaciousness' per Hareesh free render — kept void-formed (our gloss layer), his as support in lore.

lines: Any letter's beginning and end contemplated:
by void become void — void-formed the man becomes.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yasya kasyāpi varṇasya pūrvāntāv anubhāvayet | śūnyayā śūnyabhūto 'sau śūnyākāraḥ pumān bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What does perceiving a letter's ends do? → Perceiving a letter's two ends through void makes one void-formed.
c1_essence: A letter's two ends as void: void-formed man becomes.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness with piercing resolve)
